questions.question: In 2022, what was the total employment count for businesses in state FIPS code 48?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('census_business_dynamics_by_state.csv')
result = int(df[(df['year'] == 2022) & (df['st'] == 48)]['emp'].iloc[0])

questions.question: In 2022, how many more business establishments entered than exited in state FIPS code 48?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('census_business_dynamics_by_state.csv')
row = df[(df['year'] == 2022) & (df['st'] == 48)].iloc[0]
result = int(row['estabs_entry'] - row['estabs_exit'])

questions.question: Did state FIPS code 2 experience an overall net job loss in 1978?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('census_business_dynamics_by_state.csv')
val = df[(df['year'] == 1978) & (df['st'] == 2)]['net_job_creation'].iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if val < 0 else 'no'

questions.question: Among state FIPS codes 48, 49, 50, and 51, which two states had the highest number of establishments in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('census_business_dynamics_by_state.csv')
filtered = df[(df['year'] == 2022) & (df['st'].isin([48, 49, 50, 51]))]
result = filtered.sort_values(by='estabs', ascending=False)['st'].head(2).tolist()
